item.text: The client confirmed that the R$ 3.200,00 pró-labore was paid on 30 April, so it belongs in the 12 month payroll figure. I’ll finish the calculation, leave the unsupported Anexo V split explicit in the JSON, and document the remaining reconciliation gap in the library’s Anexo III split.

from decimal import Decimal as D, ROUND_HALF_UP
r=D('1020000'); f=D('284600'); s=D('78000'); l=D('6000');
aV=(r*D('.205')-D('17100'))/r
aIII=(r*D('.16')-D('35640'))/r
v=s*aV
lg=l*aIII
ln=lg*(1-D('.325'))
print('fator',f/r,'V',aV,'III',aIII,'serv',v,'loc gross',lg,'loc iss',lg*D('.325'),'loc net',ln,'total',v+ln)
for k,p in [('IRPJ','.04'),('CSLL','.035'),('COFINS','.1405'),('PIS','.0305'),('CPP','.4275')]: print(k,lg*D(p),(lg*D(p)).quantize(D('.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
print('sum percentages',sum(map(D,['.04','.035','.1405','.0305','.4275','.325'])))
print('loc split residual',lg*D('.0015'))
PY"

item.text: The DAS calculation now checks arithmetically at R$ 15.188,84. I also found that the library does not establish whether the R$ 4.500,00 training note follows the TI services’ Anexo V treatment. I’ve used that treatment as a stated assumption and will show its effect on the result.

Concluí a apuração de maio/2026: **DAS calculado de R$ 15.188,84**, com os serviços no Anexo V e a locação no Anexo III sem ISS. Os valores e a memória estão em [apuracao.json](/work/workspace/deliverable/apuracao.json) e [memoria.md](/work/workspace/deliverable/memoria.md).

O [STATUS.md](/work/workspace/deliverable/STATUS.md) registra os itens ainda abertos. A repartição por tributo permanece `null` porque falta a tabela do Anexo V na biblioteca. O total também depende da premissa de enquadrar a nota de treinamento no Anexo V; a memória mostra o cálculo alternativo.
